name: com.gameframex.unity.operationkeyboard.wechatminigame
displayName: Game Frame X Operation Keyboard (WeChat Mini Game)
description:
WeChat Mini Game keyboard adapter for GameFrameX OperationKeyboard. Implements IOperationKeyboardManager as a direct passthrough of WX.ShowKeyboard / WX.HideKeyboard / WX.UpdateKeyboard with On/OffKeyboardInput / Confirm / Complete / HeightChange events, and self-registers into OperationKeyboardRegistry at BeforeSceneLoad via WechatMiniGameOperationKeyboardBootstrap (code is stripped and registration does not happen when UNITY_WEBGL / ENABLE_WECHAT_MINI_GAME / ENABLE_WECHAT_MINI_GAME_OPERATIONKEYBOARD macros are not enabled — referencing means registering). Hide unregisters every platform event and maxLength is passed as -1 to keep pinyin composition intact. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX OperationKeyboard 的微信小游戏键盘适配渠道包。以 WX.ShowKeyboard / WX.HideKeyboard / WX.UpdateKeyboard 直通与 On/OffKeyboardInput / Confirm / Complete / HeightChange 事件实现 IOperationKeyboardManager，由 WechatMiniGameOperationKeyboardBootstrap 在 BeforeSceneLoad 阶段自注册进 OperationKeyboardRegistry（宏 UNITY_WEBGL / ENABLE_WECHAT_MINI_GAME / ENABLE_WECHAT_MINI_GAME_OPERATIONKEYBOARD 未启用时代码被裁剪、注册不发生，引用即注册）。Hide 时注销全部平台事件，maxLength 恒传 -1 以保护拼音组合输入。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
